abilities.name: Golden Wrath
abilities.rawDescription:
Rounds 1, 4, 7, and 10: deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +110%). Tactical Damage is increased by the attacker's Instinct and mitigated by the target's Intelligence.

If Sunfyre is below 75% Troop Capacity, deal this damage to a second Enemy within adjacency.

If Sunfyre is below 50% Troop Capacity, also deal Fire Damage to the same target or targets (Damage Rate: +55%), with a 50% chance to afflict each target with Burn for 2 rounds. Fire Damage is increased by the attacker's Intelligence and mitigated by the target's Initiative. Burn deals Fire Damage each round for 2 rounds (Damage Rate: +20%).

abilities.name: Sentinel's Wit
abilities.rawDescription: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase Sunfyre Tactical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

abilities.name: Radiant Majesty
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Each Round: increase the Damage Dealt of the other Ally with the most troops by +5% until the end of the round. If Sunfyre is below 75% Troop Capacity, apply this effect to both other Allies instead. If Sunfyre is below 50% Troop Capacity, also apply this effect to Sunfyre.

Habit Level progression (1–5): +5%, +6%, +7%, +8.5%, +10%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 420, 920, 1500, 2200, 3100.

abilities.name: Extinguish
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Combat: reduce Fire Damage Dealt by -13% of 1 Enemy that deals Fire Damage until the end of combat.

The summary displays -13%; the progression table displays Habit Levels 1–5 as -13.5%, -16.2%, -18.9%, -22.95%, -27%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 420, 920, 1500, 2200, 3100.

abilities.name: The King's Ire
abilities.rawDescription:
Each Round: the first time any Ally receives Fire Damage, deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane that deals Fire Damage (Damage Rate: +50%). Additionally, reduce the target's Intelligence by -15%, enhanced by Sunfyre's Instinct, for 2 rounds. This effect can trigger only once per round.

Tactical Damage Rate progression (Habit Levels 1–5): 50%, 60%, 70%, 85%, 100%. Intelligence progression: -15%, -18%, -21%, -25.5%, -30%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 420, 920, 1500, 2200, 3100.

abilities.name: Unbroken Splendor
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Combat: reduce Sunfyre's Fire Damage Received by -7% until the end of combat. Start of Each Round while below 50% Troop Capacity: reduce Sunfyre's Damage Received by -7% until the end of the round; additionally, there is a 25% chance to Cleanse 1 Negative effect that increases Damage Received, prioritizing Vulnerable.

The summary displays -7% for both reductions. Fire Damage Received progression (Habit Levels 1–5): -7.5%, -9%, -10.5%, -12.75%, -15%. Damage Received progression: -7.5%, -9%, -10.5%, -12.75%, -15%. Cleanse Chance progression: 25%, 30%, 35%, 42.5%, 50%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 420, 920, 1500, 2200, 3100.

abilities.name: Adaptive Glory
abilities.rawDescription:
Each Round, the first time Sunfyre receives Damage, activate one effect based on the damage type received. Fire Damage: apply Recovery to Sunfyre (Recovery Rate: +30%, enhanced by Instinct). Tactical Damage: increase Damage Dealt of the Ally with the most troops by +12% for 1 round. Physical Damage excluding Basic Attacks: reduce Damage Dealt of the Enemy with the most troops by -12% for 1 round. Basic Attack: increase Sunfyre Instinct by +12% and Initiative by +6% for 1 round.

Visible Recovery Rate progression (Habit Levels 1–5): 30%, 39%, 48%, 60%, 75%. Allied Damage Dealt progression: 12%, 15.6%, 19.2%, 24%, 30%. Enemy Damage Dealt progression: -12%, -15.6%, -19.2%, -24%, -30%. The screenshot does not display upgraded Instinct or Initiative values beyond the base +12% and +6%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 420, 920, 1500, 2200, 3100.
